stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon
stories.summary: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers, aiming at harder coding, debugging, and research tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: A fresh frontier model with broad access and lower task cost.

stories.headline: Google announces MKA benchmark
stories.summary: Google and Artificial Analysis launched a new benchmark for multimodal agentic knowledge work on visually complex files.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful for comparing real-world agent performance.

stories.headline: MIT publishes FLEX robot-learning study
stories.summary: MIT reported a new AI-assisted learning platform that helps robots interpret human instructions more flexibly.
stories.why_it_matters: Advances natural-language control for household robots.
